+class AggregateAnnotationPruningTests(TestCase):
+    def test_unused_aliased_aggregate_pruned(self):
+        with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
+            Book.objects.alias(
+                authors_count=Count("authors"),
+            ).count()
+        sql = ctx.captured_queries[0]["sql"].lower()

+    def test_non_aggregate_annotation_pruned(self):
+        with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
+            Book.objects.annotate(
+                name_lower=Lower("name"),
+            ).count()
+        sql = ctx.captured_queries[0]["sql"].lower()
+        self.assertEqual(sql.count("select"), 1, "No subquery wrapping required")

+            Book.objects.annotate(
+                authors_count=Count("authors"),
+            ).count()
+        sql = ctx.captured_queries[0]["sql"].lower()
+        self.assertEqual(sql.count("select"), 2, "Subquery wrapping required")
+        self.assertNotIn("authors_count", sql)
+
+    def test_referenced_aggregate_annotation_kept(self):
+        with CaptureQueriesContext(connection) as ctx:
+            Book.objects.annotate(
+                authors_count=Count("authors"),
+            ).aggregate(Avg("authors_count"))
+        sql = ctx.captured_queries[0]["sql"].lower()
+        self.assertEqual(sql.count("select"), 2, "Subquery wrapping required")
+        self.assertEqual(sql.count("authors_count"), 2)

+    def strip_unused_annotations(self):
+        """
+        Remove annotations that are not referenced by filters, other
+        annotations, or ordering so they don't have to be computed, e.g.
+        when performing a COUNT() query.
+        """
+        if not self.annotations:
+            return
+        annotations = self.annotations
+        alias_ids = {id(expr): alias for alias, expr in annotations.items()}
+        used = set()
+
+        def collect_used(node):
+            # Annotations are referenced from expressions either directly
+            # (resolved expressions share the objects stored in
+            # self.annotations) or, when unresolved, by name (F() and Ref()
+            # keep the alias they were created with).
+            if node is None:
+                return
+            if id(node) in alias_ids:
+                used.add(alias_ids[id(node)])
+            if isinstance(node, (F, Ref)):
+                name = (
+                    getattr(node, "refs", None) or node.name
+                ).split(LOOKUP_SEP)[0]
+                if name in annotations:
+                    used.add(name)
+            if hasattr(node, "get_source_expressions"):
+                for source in node.get_source_expressions():
+                    if source is not None:
+                        collect_used(source)
+            for child in getattr(node, "children", ()) or ():
+                collect_used(child)
+
+        def collect_used_name(name):
+            name = name.split(LOOKUP_SEP)[0]
+            if name in annotations:
+                used.add(name)
+
+        # Filters (the HAVING clause lives in the where tree until it is
+        # split by the compiler).
+        collect_used(self.where)
+        # Explicit grouping.
+        if isinstance(self.group_by, tuple):
+            for expr in self.group_by:
+                if isinstance(expr, str):
+                    collect_used_name(expr)
+                else:
+                    collect_used(expr)
+        # Ordering may reference annotations by name or through expressions.
+        ordering = list(self.order_by) + list(self.extra_order_by)
+        if self.default_ordering:
+            ordering += self.model._meta.ordering
+        for item in ordering:
+            if isinstance(item, str):
+                collect_used_name(item[1:] if item.startswith("-") else item)
+            else:
+                collect_used(item)
+        # Annotations referenced by used annotations are used as well.
+        while True:
+            size = len(used)
+            for alias in list(used):
+                collect_used(annotations[alias])
+            if len(used) == size:
